subject: Azure publisher account activation + technical validation / co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Publisher Team <azure-pubs@microsoft.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Azure publisher account activation + technical validation / co-sell readiness

Hi team,

We're kicking off our Azure Marketplace listing and want to make sure we align on the publisher account activation and the technical validation required for co-sell enablement. We have a dedicated private deployment option (VPC/on-prem) and a hosted offer — both need to be represented in the offer types.

High-level asks:
- Confirm publisher registration status for Redwood Inference (we submitted the initial form last week).
- Share the technical validation checklist and the expected artifacts (tenant IDs, test offer image, ARM template or SaaS connector info).
- Outline co-sell prerequisites (partner center configuration, required SKUs, and any sales certification).
- Proposed timeline: aim for technical validation window next week, then co-sell nomination the week after.

I've attached: publisher_registration.pdf (registration confirmation and contact info), redwood-azure-arch.png (architecture diagram showing hosted/dedicated/private deployment options), and a one-page mutual-action-plan draft.

Can Samir or someone from the Publisher team confirm next steps and available validation slots? We'll have engineers on standby for a short review call.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@microsoft.com>

Cc: Partner Success <partner-success@microsoft.com>, Azure Marketplace Publisher Team <azure-pubs@microsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Azure publisher account activation + technical validation / co-sell readiness

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick status: we see your publisher registration in Partner Center but it's still in "Verification" pending a few items we need to validate for co-sell. I'll list the items below and propose slots.

Required technical validation items (short):
1) Tenant ID and publisher GUID (we need these to create the offer draft)
2) Test offer access: temporary test account or SaaS endpoint with dev/test key so our validation team can exercise the API end-to-end
3) ARM/Helm/installer or SaaS connector: for your hosted API offer include deployment template or connector steps
4) Security/compliance evidence: SOC 2 cert or equivalent and data-retention policy doc
5) Offer metering/plan matrix: expected SKUs and pricing tiers for the Marketplace listing

Co-sell pre-reqs:
- Partner Center: company profile complete and tax info validated
- Microsoft Partner Network: registration with active MPN ID
- Co-sell nomination: after technical validation, we request a short sales playbook and target accounts list

We have a technical validation slot on Wed Feb 18 14:00-15:00 PT. Can your engineering lead join for a brief demo and API smoke test? If not, we can do Thu Feb 19 09:00-10:00 PT.

Next steps: please send tenant ID + test-access details and confirm a slot. Also, upload the SOC 2 and the offer assets (icons, screenshots) to Partner Center or share a secure link.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Principal Publisher Onboarding
Microsoft Corporation
samir.patel@microsoft.com

Note: For convenience, here's the Publisher checklist link: https://aka.ms/azure-marketplace-publisher-checklist

> Hi Marissa —
> 
> Thanks for the clear summary. Quick status: we see your publisher registration in Partner Center but it's still in "Verification" pending a few items we need to validate for co-sell. I'll list the items below and propose slots.

Thanks Samir — we can do the Wed Feb 18 14:00 PT slot.

Quick answers / artifacts attached inline:
- Tenant ID: 7f3a8b2c-2e4f-4c1b-a123-9f7d6e7b2a11
- Test offer access: created a sandbox API key (test_key_azure_2026) and a short-lived test user (demo@redwood-test.io) — docs in the attached mutual-action-plan and endpoint notes in the architecture image.
- ARM template: included as part of the mutual-action-plan.xlsx tab "ARM" (we also have a Helm chart if reviewers prefer).
- SOC 2: attaching the certificate excerpt in the publisher_registration.pdf (page 2). If you need the full attestation, let me know and I'll arrange a secure upload.
- SKU/pricing matrix: see the "Pricing" tab in the mutual-action-plan.xlsx — we propose Free Trial (1000 tokens), Standard, and Enterprise (dedicated capacity).

Vanessa and Rishi will join the call for commercial alignment. Our engineering lead (Ethan Park) will be on the technical call.

Proposed agenda for validation call:
- 5m intros and scope
- 15m demo: API connectivity, authentication, telemetry
- 20m smoke tests: offer provisioning and API calls from Marketplace flow
- 10m next steps: co-sell nomination checklist and DocuSign for publisher agreement

See attachments; we also added a light mutual action plan that maps owners / target dates.

Thanks — see you on the call.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships

Marissa —

Great, thanks for the artifacts and the slot. Confirming the technical validation is scheduled for Wed Feb 18 14:00 PT and the validation team will run the smoke tests you outlined.

Follow-ups after validation (tentative):
- We'll provision a draft offer in Partner Center and share the preview link for your review.
- Co-sell nomination checklist will be sent once technical validation passes — expect a short form and DocuSign for the publisher agreement.
- I'll send the DocuSign link for the publisher agreement and co-sell acknowledgment shortly after the call.

One small ask for the validation run: please whitelist the following IP ranges for the validation agent or ensure the sandbox key allows calls from Microsoft test agents — I can share the exact agent IPs prior to the call.

If everything passes, there's typically a 3–5 business day window to move from validated -> co-sell nomination ready. We'll coordinate the nomination with our Partner Success team.

See you on Wed.

Best,
Samir
